title: Evidence investigation
when: An argument rests on several kinds of evidence.
story: Observation, inference, missing comparison, then the test that could change the conclusion.
picture: The report's own pages (a canvas `document`), each claim marked on the words that make it; the camera moves between details of one page.
pace: Patient reading, purposeful pushes, one decisive reveal.
rules: Keep observation and inference visibly distinct.
Keep the report title, page or section with each real claim.
